Members

(module scope)

TSL node shorthand — the fluent node graph (.mul().add()…) is fully dynamic; one file-local alias keeps the builder readable instead of fighting per-call generics.

(module scope)

Live uniform handle shared between the builders and updateFx.

time

Scene-seconds uniform — updateFx writes s.t into .value.

rodrigues

Rotates position p around axis k by angle a — Rodrigues' rotation formula: p·cos a + (k×p)·sin a + k·(k·p)·(1−cos a). Used to swirl the weather sample point around each hurricane's eye axis.

weatherField

The shared weather field — returns { density, ash, snow, day } nodes sampled at positionLocal, so the cloud deck and the surface shadow read the SAME sky in the same frame. positionLocal is object space, meaning the field co-rotates with the body while the internal drift terms add the atmosphere's own differential motion on top.

  • @param TSL three/tsl namespace.
  • @param time Shared time uniform (scene seconds).
  • @param sunDirU Shared sun-direction uniform node — its Y doubles as
  • @param cloudTex The real 8k cloud map steering large-scale coverage.
  • @returns Field nodes: cloud density, ash darkness, snow cover, dayF.

makeWeatherClouds

Builds the living cloud deck + applies the matching surface shadow — a lit MeshStandardNodeMaterial so the deck takes real sun shading (bright limb, dark night side, true terminator) instead of the old additive white wash. surfaceMat gets a colorNode multiplying the day-side diffuse by 1 − SHADOW·density so thick weather visibly dims the ground beneath it. The shared fxTime uniform drives field evolution (updateFx writes it once per frame).

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param deps TSL namespace + node-material ctors.
  • @param def Catalog entry (radius sizes the shell).
  • @param cloudTex Loaded 8k cloud map (coverage steering).
  • @param sunDir Shared day/night sun-direction vector.
  • @param surfaceMat The body's surface material (node path only).
  • @param time Shared scene-time uniform node (s.fxTime).

makeAurora

Aurora curtains — a thin rayed emission OVAL centered on the body's MAGNETIC pole (the tilt offsets the sampling frame by the dipole angle, so Neptune's wildly offset field draws a swung oval, not a symmetric polar cap). Two shells stack the curtain: the lower ring hugs the atmosphere at SHELL_SCALE, an upper ring at SHELL_SCALE2 with poleward-shifted latitude reads as curtain tops standing off the limb. Longitude fbm provides both the oval's substorm buckling and the high-frequency curtain rays; the shared wind uniform gates brightness so a solar storm ignites every aurora-bearing world in the same frame, and the optional sun-direction uniform dims the day-side arc (UV emission runs in sunlight — it just doesn't show).

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param deps TSL namespace + node-material ctors.
  • @param def Catalog entry — aurora carries the per-body palette,
  • @param time Shared time uniform node (updateFx-driven).
  • @param wind Shared solar-wind uniform node (updateFx-driven).
  • @param sunDir Shared sun-direction vector when the body registers

makeConstellation

Starlink-class constellation — a count-point cloud on one inclined orbital shell: each satellite is a single lit pixel glinting as it laps the planet, and the whole shell precesses as a unit on its pivot (frame.ts rotates it like a satellite pivot). Raycast is stubbed so the swarm can never steal a body click.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry — constellation carries count/orbit.

makeSolarFlares

Solar limb flares — FLARE_N seeded prominence sprites rooted at the photosphere edge of the Sun's equatorial band. updateFx scales them by wind × sin⁴(phase + t·rate) so eruptions breathe with the activity cycle and spike outward when storms hit.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry (Sun).
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-glow texture for the sprite maps.
  • @returns Flare records for the node's flares list.

makeMeteorPool

Meteor flash pool — SF_METEOR.POOL additive glow sprites parented to the cratered body's mesh, all dormant (opacity 0). updateFx fires a slot at a random surface point when meteorNext elapses and fades it over SF_METEOR.LIFE, so a body like Callisto reads as still being bombarded — matching the "saturated with craters" dossier — instead of standing geologically dead.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry (meteors-flagged).
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-glow texture for the flash map.
